entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please wait while we connect you to the next available agent.
Hi, you've reached VeloFit. My name is Alex. How can I help you today?
Hello Alex. I'm calling because I'd like to return a helmet I purchased.
I can certainly help you with that. Do you have the order number handy?
Thank you. Let me pull that up... I see the order for the Aero-Dynamic Helmet, placed about 50 days ago. To make sure I understand the situation, what specifically is the issue with the item?
Oh, there's no problem with the helmet itself. It's just that the color doesn't match my new bike as well as I'd hoped.
Okay, so it's a preference issue with the color, not a technical fault or a safety concern?
That's right. I haven't even taken it out of the packaging. The box is completely unopened.

I understand. Getting the right look is part of the experience. Let me check the return eligibility for you... Okay, great news. Since the item was delivered 50 days ago, it's well within our 90-day return window. I can go ahead and approve this return for a full refund.

That's good to hear. Now, out of curiosity, shipping it back is a bit of a hassle. Would you consider offering a 15% credit for me to just keep it? It is a high-quality helmet, and its safety rating is excellent, so I'm not opposed to keeping it if there's a small incentive.

I appreciate you asking, and I definitely understand wanting to avoid the return process. However, my system only allows me to process a full return and refund for preference-based requests. We don't have a policy for partial credits in this situation.
I see. No discount code for a future purchase then, to offset the inconvenience?

Unfortunately, I'm not authorized to provide discount codes for this type of return. But I can assure you the return is very easy. I've just initiated it and I'm sending you a prepaid shipping label by email now. All you'll need to do is attach it to the box unopened, and drop it with the carrier.
Alright, a full refund is perfectly acceptable. I was just exploring my options. I'll probably just reorder the same helmet in a different color. Thanks for your help.
You're very welcome. That email is on its way to you now. Is there anything else I can assist you with today?
No, that's everything. Thank you, Alex.
My pleasure. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and have a great day.
